WITH picked AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM leads
    WHERE status = 'enriched'
      AND email IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(email) <> ''
      AND retry_count < {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }}
    ORDER BY enriched_at ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC
    LIMIT {{ $('config').first().json.batchSize }}
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE leads l
SET
    status     = 'auditing',
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM picked
WHERE l.id = picked.id
RETURNING
    l.id,
    l.business_name,
    l.city,
    l.category,
    l.website_url,
    l.email,
    l.pagespeed_score,
    l.seo_score,
    l.mobile_score,
    l.pain_points,
    l.scraped_html,
    l.retry_count;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('config').first().json.workflowName }}',
  NOW(),
  0,
  0,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - '{{ $('config').first().json.runStartTs }}'::timestamptz)) * 1000,
  'no enriched leads with email in queue'
);

UPDATE leads
SET
    audit_summary      = '{{ $json.audit_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    personalized_email = '{{ $json.personalized_email.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    email_subject      = '{{ $json.email_subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    status             = 'approved',
    audited_at         = NOW(),
    updated_at         = NOW(),
    failure_reason     = NULL
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

UPDATE leads
SET
    failure_reason = '{{ ($json.failure_reason || 'openai audit failed').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    retry_count    = retry_count + 1,
    status         = CASE
                       WHEN retry_count + 1 >= {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }} THEN 'audit_failed'
                       ELSE 'enriched'
                     END,
    updated_at     = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.workflow_name }}',
  NOW(),
  {{ $json.leads_processed }},
  {{ $json.leads_failed }},
  {{ $json.duration_ms }},
  '{{ $json.notes.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);

UPDATE leads
SET
    failure_reason = '{{ ($json.failure_reason || 'workflow crash during audit').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    retry_count    = retry_count + 1,
    status         = CASE
                       WHEN retry_count + 1 >= {{ $('config').first().json.maxRetries }} THEN 'audit_failed'
                       ELSE 'enriched'
                     END,
    updated_at     = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
  AND status = 'auditing';

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
  workflow_name,
  run_at,
  leads_processed,
  leads_failed,
  duration_ms,
  notes
) VALUES (
  'audit_error',
  NOW(),
  0,
  1,

  'lead_id={{ $json.id }} | {{ ($json.failure_reason || 'unhandled error').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
